_doc: T-391/T-410: the PUBLISHED PvP reward rates (honest-economy guardrail — these numbers are the contract; the UI reads them, the server enforces them). honor: per rated match — every participant earns participation_base (GW2-pips lesson: a loss still pays); the winner adds win_bonus; rating_bonus adds 1 per 100 rating above 1000 capped at rating_bonus_cap (WoW-arena climb incentive); upset_bonus pays a winner who beat a higher-rated opponent; catchup multiplies a LOSER's total when their rating is below catchup_below_rating (bounded loss-aversion antidote — the bottom of the ladder always progresses). tracks: selectable reward tracks; spending honor completes tiers in order; each tier lands ONE unlock on the T-375 cosmetic seam (title: ids are display-only titles). rarity may NEVER exceed 'rare' (power-never-for-sale charter; tested). pacing: the authoring contract T-410 added — total track honor / observed_honor_per_night, in weeks, must stay >= target_weeks_to_clear_tracks (a data lint so future authoring can't shrink the chase back to nights). commendation: T-410 terminal, repeatable sink — once a player has cleared the tracks they can afford, surplus honor buys seasonal commendations indefinitely at a data-tunable cost. Each buy is overdraft-guarded and ledgered (reason 'commendation'); the T-395 account-mastery floor will consume the accumulated count. Purely horizontal (no cosmetic, no power); it NEVER exhausts, so honor is never inert. season_payout: at season rollover each participant's best tier grants one prestige unlock, idempotent.

honor_bg._doc: T-413: published rates for the 'bg' bracket (Crownfield 3v3, 6 players/match after the 2026-07-16 owner ruling). Rates are PER PLAYER, so team size never moves the pacing floor. A BG match runs ~5-8 min vs a ~1 min duel, so it pays roughly double per match while a BG-only night stays at duel parity (see pacing.bg_matches_per_night). Same shape as 'honor': every participant earns participation_base (a loss still pays), winner adds win_bonus (+rating/upset bonuses), low-rated losers get the catch-up multiplier. Ledger reason is 'bg_match' (distinct from duels' 'match').

pacing._doc: Observed rate (fun-audit run 2): ~20 rated duels/night at ~50% win = ~280 honor/night. Total track honor authored below is 7830 -> 7830/280 = 27.96 nights = 3.99 weeks. A high-rated earner (~330/night with rating+upset bonuses) still needs ~23.7 nights = 3.4 weeks. Both land inside the 3-4 week acceptance band; the terminal commendation sink covers everything after. T-413: a BG-only night is bg_matches_per_night matches at ~50% win on the honor_bg rates = 10 * (20 + 14/2) = 270/night <= 280, so the battleground cannot shrink the chase below the floor (linted in test_pvp_honor.gd). Rates are per-player, so the 2026-07-16 flip to 3v3 (6 players/match) leaves this pacing untouched.

commendation._doc: Repeatable, indefinite. Deducts `cost` honor (overdraft-guarded exactly like a track spend) and writes a ledger row with reason 'commendation'. Grants no cosmetic and no power — the accumulated count IS the record, which the T-395 account-mastery floor will later consume. Never exhausts, so a player who owns every affordable cosmetic still has an evergreen honor use.
